results.name: Default /favicon.ico returns HTTP 404
results.details: Server returned HTTP 404 with a full 15072 byte HTML error page for /favicon.ico.
results.reproduction:
1. Open browser network tab.
2. Navigate to https://www.cynbit.in/favicon.ico or watch auto-load.
3. Observe 404 error response.
results.recommendation: Add a standard 32x32 /favicon.ico file to /public directory or configure next.config.js rewrite to /favicon.svg.

results.name: Temporary 307 Redirect on Apex Domain instead of 301
results.details: https://cynbit.in redirects with HTTP 307 (Temporary Redirect) to https://www.cynbit.in/ instead of 301 Permanent Redirect.
results.reproduction:
1. Send HEAD request to https://cynbit.in.
2. Inspect response status code (307) and location header.
results.recommendation: Change redirect rule in vercel.json or Next.js middleware to permanent 301 to preserve link equity and eliminate caching ambiguities.

results.name: Missing Critical Security Response Headers
results.details: Missing security headers: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy. Leaves site vulnerable to Clickjacking (missing X-Frame-Options) and MIME-type sniffing.
results.reproduction:
1. Inspect HTTP response headers for https://www.cynbit.in/.
2. Confirm absence of CSP, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options.
results.recommendation: Configure security headers in next.config.js under `async headers()` method.

results.name: Sitemap URLs Point to Redirecting Apex Domain
results.details: All 82 sitemap entries use apex domain (https://cynbit.in), triggering 307 redirects for every crawler page hit.
results.reproduction:
1. Fetch https://www.cynbit.in/sitemap.xml.
2. Check `<loc>` URLs - all start with https://cynbit.in which then redirects.
results.recommendation: Update sitemap generator metadata `metadataBase` in layout.tsx to 'https://www.cynbit.in' so URLs match canonical destination.

results.name: Career Application Form Unassociated Labels (22/23 disconnected)
results.details: 22 out of 23 form labels lack 'for' attributes and do not enclose input controls. Assistive technologies fail to announce field purposes.
results.reproduction:
1. Navigate to https://www.cynbit.in/careers/qa-testing-intern.
2. Inspect form controls inside #application-form.
3. Click on any field label ('Full Name*', 'Email Address*'). Observe input does not receive focus.
results.recommendation: Assign unique IDs to each input element and match them with <label htmlFor={id}> attributes.

results.name: Missing 'name' Attributes on Career Form Controls (8 inputs)
results.details: 8 input/select elements (e.g. Qualification, Degree, Graduation Year) lack 'name' attributes. Native form submissions and autocomplete autofill fail to populate.
results.reproduction:
1. Inspect DOM on /careers/qa-testing-intern.
2. Review select dropdowns and score inputs.
3. Note missing name attribute.
results.recommendation: Add explicit, descriptive 'name' attributes matching backend schema (e.g. name='graduationYear', name='degree').

results.name: Contact Page Form Completely Disconnected Labels (5/5 unassociated)
results.details: 100% of labels on the Contact Form have no 'for' attributes and none of the input fields have 'id' attributes.
results.reproduction:
1. Navigate to https://www.cynbit.in/contact.
2. Inspect input fields 'Full Name', 'Email Address', 'Your Message'.
3. Click labels; observe input is not focused.
results.recommendation: Add `id` to inputs and connect with `htmlFor` on labels.

results.name: Social Media Icon Links Lack Accessible Names (4/4 links)
results.details: Social anchor tags (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram) have no textual content and no aria-label. Screen readers announce 'empty link' or raw URL.
results.reproduction:
1. Inspect footer social icon links on homepage.
2. Observe <a href='https://...'> without text or aria-label.
results.recommendation: Add aria-label='Follow Cynbit on LinkedIn' (and corresponding platform names) to each anchor tag.

results.name: Header 'Join Us' Button Triggers Newsletter Instead of Careers
results.details: Primary Call to Action 'Join Us' in top navigation bar opens a newsletter subscription popup rather than routing to /careers or hiring pipeline.
results.reproduction:
1. Visit Cynbit homepage.
2. Click 'Join Us' in top right header.
3. Observe newsletter modal appears instead of careers/hiring information.
results.recommendation: Rename button to 'Subscribe' or redirect 'Join Us' directly to '/careers' or '/bitelevate' where users actually join the company/program.
